name: sheet-03
description: Right-side cart sheet with editable quantities, a running subtotal, and a checkout action.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Minus as MinusIcon, Plus as PlusIcon, ShoppingCart as ShoppingCartIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/sheet" const initialItems = [ { id: "mug", name: "Portfolio Simple template", variant: "Next.js · Figma", price: 18, qty: 2, }, { id: "tote", name: "Icons Pack", variant: "4000+ icons", price: 24, qty: 1 }, { id: "candle", name: "Logos Pack", variant: "SVG · React", price: 32, qty: 1 }, ] export default function ShoppingCartSheet() { const [items, setItems] = React.useState(initialItems) const subtotal = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.qty, 0) const count = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.qty, 0) function update(id: string, delta: number) { setItems((prev) => prev .map((item) => item.id === id ? { ...item, qty: item.qty + delta } : item ) .filter((item) => item.qty > 0) ) } return ( }> Cart ({count}) Your cart {count} items ready for checkout.
